profiles.label: BMW Z3 3.0i (roadster & coupe)
profiles.framing: A characterful fair-weather weekend and daily driver, NOT a collector or investment car. The buyer values reliability, condition, driving engagement, value, and proximity to Carmel / Monterey / Bay Area. Factory manual gearbox only; the 3.0L M54 is the minimum engine.
profiles.weak_points: REAR SUBFRAME / trunk-floor differential-mount cracking or tearing (the signature structural failure; inspect from below AND the trunk spot welds). Cooling system (~50-80k lifespan: water pump, thermostat, radiator, expansion tank) on the M54. VANOS rattle/wear. DISA valve rattle. Valve-cover and oil filter housing leaks. Rear trailing-arm bushings. Window regulators. Convertible-top mechanism and rear-window separation (roadster). Cluster pixel fade. Cracked or warped dashboard. Rust at rockers, floors, subframe mounts.
profiles.immediate_repairs: cooling-system refresh, tires, fluids, convertible-top inspection
profiles.repairs_12mo: VANOS service, rear subframe inspection/reinforcement, soft-top or rear-window repair, clutch if worn
profiles.market_notes: Coupes command a substantial premium over roadsters. Low-mile, unmodified, documented cars sell quickly; automatics and 2.5i/2.8i cars trade well below.

checks.label: Cooling overhaul — radiator, expansion tank, water pump, thermostat, hoses
Rear subframe mounts / floor reinforcement (chassis cracking)
Convertible top operation, hydraulics/motor, rear window (roadster)
Clutch / flywheel wear & rear main seal leak
Oil leaks — valve cover, oil filter housing, oil pan
Rust at rockers / floors / subframe mounts

profiles.label: BMW Z3 M (M roadster & M coupe)
profiles.framing: A characterful fair-weather weekend and daily driver, NOT a collector or investment car. The buyer values reliability, condition, driving engagement, value, and proximity to Carmel / Monterey / Bay Area. All Z3 M cars are factory manual. Identify the engine: 1998-2000 = S52 (more robust); 2001-2002 = S54 (rod-bearing design flaw, VANOS failures common and costly).
profiles.weak_points: REAR SUBFRAME / trunk-floor differential-mount cracking or tearing (worst on the M; inspect from below AND the trunk spot welds; reinforcement plates are the fix). S54: rod bearings (preventive replacement with upgraded bearings + oil analysis), double-VANOS failures. S52: cooling system, VANOS rattle. Finned differential mounts. Valve-cover and oil filter housing leaks. Rear trailing-arm bushings. Window regulators. Convertible-top mechanism (roadster). Cluster pixels. Cracked dashboard. Rust at rockers/floors.
profiles.immediate_repairs: cooling-system refresh, tires, fluids, oil analysis (S54)
profiles.repairs_12mo: rod bearings (S54, if not documented), VANOS service, rear subframe reinforcement, clutch if worn
profiles.market_notes: M coupes are the most valuable Z3 variant by a wide margin, with S54 coupes at the top. Documented rod-bearing and subframe work materially raises value. Mileage matters less than documentation on these cars.

checks.label: Rear subframe mounts / floor reinforcement (chassis cracking; critical on M coupe)
VANOS operation — rattle / seals (S52 single; S54 double)
Cooling overhaul — radiator, expansion tank, water pump, thermostat, hoses
Convertible top operation, hydraulics/motor, rear window (roadster)
Clutch / flywheel wear & rear main seal leak
Oil leaks — valve cover, oil filter housing, oil pan
Rust at rockers / floors / subframe mounts

dealbreakers: S54 with no rod-bearing history AND no PPI possible

profiles.label: Lexus GX460
profiles.framing: A capable daily/family hauler for dogs, gear, light camping and off-road use. The buyer values reliability, value, cargo/dog/gear space, family use, proximity to Carmel / Bay Area, adventure capability, and overall feel.
profiles.weak_points: KDSS hydraulic leaks or lean. Secondary air injection pump failures (P2440/P2442; expensive). Valley-plate coolant leak and timing-cover seepage on the 1UR-FE. Transfer case actuator. Suspension bushing and shock wear. Cheap lifts and questionable modifications. Towing history. Frame rust on non-western cars.
profiles.immediate_repairs: worn tires, due fluids, secondary air injection if codes present
profiles.repairs_12mo: KDSS service, suspension bushings, brake hardware, transmission service
profiles.market_notes: Later years (2014+ refresh, 2020+ with updated infotainment) carry premiums. Luxury and Premium trims with records sell fastest. Air-injection and KDSS history are the questions that move price.

checks.label: Transmission / transfer case / differential fluid history

dealbreakers: Active secondary air injection fault with no price adjustment

profiles.label: Lexus GX470
profiles.framing: A capable daily/family hauler for dogs, gear, light camping and off-road use. The buyer values reliability, value, cargo/dog/gear space, family use, proximity to Carmel / Bay Area, adventure capability, and overall feel.
profiles.weak_points: Timing belt / water pump (interval 90k; verify date AND mileage). Rear air suspension bags and height-control compressor (or a quality delete kit). OEM plastic-tank radiator failures. Frame / undercarriage rust on non-western cars. Lower ball joints (recall history). Exhaust manifold tick / cracks. Cracked dashboard. Secondary air injection on later years. Transfer case and differential fluid neglect. Cheap lifts and questionable modifications.
profiles.immediate_repairs: worn tires, due fluids, aging radiator, timing belt if past interval
profiles.repairs_12mo: rear air bags coming due, transmission service, brake hardware, suspension bushings
profiles.market_notes: Clean, unmodified, high-mileage GX470s from dry states hold value well. Timing-belt documentation and rear-suspension status are the two biggest price drivers; heavily modified overland builds trade at a discount to stock examples with records.

checks.label: Rear air suspension status (or delete kit)
Transmission / transfer case / differential fluid history

dealbreakers: Timing belt unknown AND mileage over 180k with no budget noted
